judge.rationale: The candidate delivers a clean, working implementation that satisfies every acceptance criterion in the issue. For the requirement that 'The type of what the hook receives makes the answer unambiguous', the candidate literally introduces a `TurnUsage` type alias for `UsageMetadata` (specifically following the tech note hinting at `src/types/ai.ts`), whereas the reference simply renamed the parameter to `totalUsage?: UsageMetadata`. The candidate also actually tests a turn with *two* tool rounds (three provider calls total) as specified in the first acceptance criterion, whereas the reference only tested one tool round (two provider calls). Minor differences from the reference include placing the helper in `orchestratorHelpers.ts`, adding a separate acceptance test file instead of extending `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, and leaving a `.lore/dod.md` artifact in the tree.
